Overview

Tarapoto is a city in SM with a population of 180,000. The City of Palms, a gateway to the Peruvian Amazon with waterfalls, wildlife, and tropical fruit. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
